notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE (36 copies sold/Christmass update)
notes.content:
Thank you for buying frog corner and as a thank you we are giving you a MAJOR update for the game

And what does the update include?

Well it concludes a lot of things so lets get to the broad Change Logs:

[h3][b]Change logs[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]Added [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
[*]Added [b]SECRET SETTINGS[/b] (interesting and fun settings that are locked with achievements)
[*]Added [b]NEW GAME+[/b] (an interesting and harder way to play the base game)
[*]Added [b]MORE FROGS IN CORNERS[/b] (no comment (fake))
[*]fixed some bugs
[*]Changes some puzzles to make them clearer/easier
[*]And more things that are not visible/interesting
[/list]

Now thats cool and... nice but lets get to the details:

[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]

With popular demand Achievements now are in the game.
Now the game is populated by an astounding [b]28[/b] achievements!
These achievements range from story/progresion, "collectables" and just a bunch of fun and weird achievments.

[h3][b]Secret settings[/b][/h3]

Now this is "secret"
there is 4 new secret achievements with all being vastly diffrent and interesting.
(and some maybe helping with achievements wink wink)
these include:
[list]
[*]Speedrun timer (its a speedrun timer allright ([b]needed for speedrun achievements[/b]))
[*]Froggest corner (i'll let you figgure what it does)
[*]Frog Vision (make vision more froggy) 
[*]And the MASSIVE thing which is:
[/list]

[h3][b]NEW GAME+[/b][/h3]

Now this is where is the heat is. New game plus is an reamagining of the base game that makes is harder and interesting to play again.
ir adds new puzzles changes some old ones and makes old enemy encounters more harder or interesting.

[h3][b]More frogs in the corners[/b][/h3]

As of much debate in the negative side of the reviews. AND WE HEAR YOU
we added SO many more frog in the corners I cant even count the x times the amount of frogs on my fingers.
so i hope you have a better time with our game with more frogs been added.

[h3][b]Final notes[/b][/h3]

[b]THANK YOU[/b]. without you this game wouldn't even exist and thank you for all of the 36 people who bought this game you are the REAL frogs in the corner my friend, because this frog has finally found its corner.
